body:
It would be nice to have a small sentence why this default order was chosen: 

```
::: tip

The default values and order for `python_binary` was chosen to first identify the 
Python version in a virtualenv/conda environments (which currently still add a `python` symlink,
no matter if it points to `python3` or `python2`). This has the side effect that if you have
still a system Python 2 installed, it will be picked up before any Python 3 
(at least on Linux, were `/usr/bin/python` is always a symlink to a Python 2). If you
do not work with Python 2 anymore but cannot remove the system Python 2, 
changing this to `["python3"]` will hide any Python 2. 
```
